figurative_meaning_en: Group of yes-men, sycophants or flatterers
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাজনৈতিক দলে অনেক জো-হুকুমের দলের লোক থাকে।
সে তার বসের জো-হুকুমের দলের সদস্য হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Many yes-men are found in political parties.
He has become a member of his boss's sycophant group.
note: This idiom critiques blind loyalty in hierarchical structures common in Bengali society.
